title: Soulstones placed
quote: I need to see who is carrying a soulstone before the pull, not find out when the tank wipes us.
what: A small list of who currently has a Soulstone Resurrection on them, who placed it, and how long is left on the 30 minute buff. It warns when a healer or tank in the raid has none, and when a placed stone is about to expire.
possible: Partly on Era and TBC (the combat log shows the stone being applied to anyone). On Forever only the player's own aura can be read and other players' auras are secret, so only addon users would show.
today: Today: only the warlock's Soulstone cast and its 30 minute item cooldown are tracked; who holds a stone is not.

title: World buff check
quote: Half the raid dropped Songflower and Zandalar before the pull and nobody noticed until Onyxia.
what: A strip like the flask and food count for world buffs (Rallying Cry of the Dragonslayer, Spirit of Zandalar, Songflower, Warchief's Blessing, the Dire Maul tribute buffs), with time left and a list of who lacks them. Useful for a 3 hour raid where buffs expire mid-night.
possible: Partly on Era and TBC (raid members' auras are readable, so non-addon players show). On Forever each player's own client would have to report it, so addon users only.
today: Today: only flask and food categories exist; no world buffs, and no other category can be counted.

title: Flask and food for people without the addon
quote: In a 40 man most of my raid has no addon, so the flask count says 6 of 6 while 34 people are unbuffed.
what: On Era and TBC, read every raid member's auras directly and fill in the flask, food and elixir status for them, with the addon-only broadcast kept for Forever. The count becomes real for the whole raid and names the ones missing it.
possible: Partly on Era, TBC and MoP (raid auras are readable). Not possible on Forever for others, since auras are secret there.
today: Today: each client polls only its own auras and broadcasts them, so the count covers addon users only.

title: Protection potion and consumable categories
quote: For Chromaggus and Sapphiron I want to see who has their resist potion or Greater Fire Protection up, not just flasks.
what: Add more consumable categories to the built-in list and the Essentials strip: protection potions, elixirs, juju, weapon oil and zanza. Players choose which categories to show per raid night.
possible: Possible on every client for the user's own buffs. Everyone's buffs show on Era and TBC; Forever shows addon users.
today: Today: built-ins are four flasks and Well Fed only; extras need /cdc consumable by hand and only count as flask or food.

title: Cooldowns survive a reload or crash
quote: I disconnect in the middle of a three hour raid and my Lay on Hands timer comes back as ready.
what: Save each recorded cooldown with a real clock time and restore it after /reload, a crash or a relog if the cooldown has not run out. Long cooldowns like Lay on Hands, Divine Intervention and Rebirth stay correct for the whole night.
possible: Possible on every client. Others' cooldowns are re-read from the log or the owner's addon after returning.
today: Today: cooldown state lives in memory only, so a reload or disconnect clears every timer.

title: Missing classic raid tools
quote: The list has Innervate but not Reincarnation, Fear Ward or Divine Intervention's real use, so my raid still needs a spreadsheet.
what: Add Classic cooldowns raiders plan around: Shaman Reincarnation, Fear Ward, Mind Control, Last Stand, Hunter Tranquilizing Shot, and Engineering items like Goblin Sapper Charge. The player can still untick any of them.
possible: Possible on Era, TBC and Forever (spell list work). Item cooldowns like the Sapper share the Soulstone problem: the game cannot say when they are ready.
today: Today: Era and Forever track 12 spells; none of these are in the list.

title: Rebirth and Soulstone as one resurrection pool
quote: When someone dies I want to see in one line who can bring them back right now: druid, soulstoned, or shaman Ankh.
what: A single Resurrection row that adds up ready Rebirth druids, players with a placed Soulstone and shamans with Reincarnation, and shows the next one to come off cooldown. Click or slash to announce who should rez whom.
possible: Partly on Era and TBC (the log sees druid and warlock casts). On Forever only addon users count.
today: Today: Rebirth appears as a Battle Rez provider; Soulstone is tracked but never listed as a rez source, and Request Rez names only battle rez providers.

title: Raid group sort by class group
quote: With 40 names the list is a wall, and I only care about my healers' Innervate and my tanks' Shield Wall.
what: Group the panel by class or by a subgroup of the raid (tank group, healer group, group 1 to 8) with collapsible headers, so a 40 player roster is readable at a glance.
possible: Possible on every client; subgroup info is read from the raid roster.
today: Today: one flat list of every tracked spell with owner names, with no grouping by subgroup or class.
